scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && pnpm db:up && concurrently -n api,worker,web,sink -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm --filter api run dev" "pnpm --filter worker run dev" "pnpm --filter web run dev" "pnpm sink"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tools
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter api run test:e2e && pnpm db:up && pnpm --filter web run test:e2e
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build
scripts.db:up: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && docker compose up -d --wait db
